notes.title: Hey, I made a cute little fishing game.
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40929621/d9dc24c3be4a22749b0a4cc42c31dd824504204e.png[/img]

My next game is coming soon and will be released by Oakrot Games on Steam. It's called [b]Fishing Game[/b].

Fishing game is an itty bitty game inspired by the fishing minigame in Stardew Valley and Animal Crossing. I really loved the fishing mini game in Stardew Valley and Animal Crossing and made a game trying to smush the two together. It’s got a bunch of goofy writing and a handful of spicy gimmicks. I would really appreciate it if you would check out the game’s store page and Wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2112150/Fishing_Game/

Hope you guys enjoy it!

You can follow Oakrot Games on social media to see Fishing Game teasers planned until the game releases near the end of the month.
